title: Broadside missing routes declared in read_only_paths()
description: broadside/src/bookwyrm_api.rs routes() omits SHELVES_PATH and SHELF_STATUS_PATH that are declared in fieldwork::bookwyrm_api::read_only_paths(). broadside/src/funkwhale_api.rs routes() omits PLAYLIST_TRACKS_PATH, CHANNEL_PATH, PODCAST_RSS_PATH, and LISTEN_PATH that are declared in fieldwork::funkwhale_api::read_only_paths(). Either the read_only_paths() declarations are aspirational (not yet implemented) or broadside has route gaps. If read_only_paths() is the source of truth for what should be served, these are missing endpoints that will 404.
close_reason: Accepted: broadside intentionally serves a subset of read-only routes. Shelf endpoints require user context (no auth in broadside). Funkwhale playlist_tracks/channel/podcast/listen need content that broadside doesn't host. The read_only_paths() function documents the full contract; broadside implements what makes sense for broadcast-only.
